prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent 2D hostile projectile sprite for BOSS-001 in Survival Arena, reused by both the boss's fan and ring attacks. Supplied image 1 is the existing enemy sling-stone projectile and is a style/contrast reference only; supplied image 2 is the boss body and is a theme reference only. Create ONE compact, nearly circular stylized iron-and-brass mace-head projectile with a broad readable dark core and a clear warm coral-red danger rim. It should read instantly at 20–32 pixels on screen and remain visually distinct from the small brown sling stone. Hand-painted storybook cutout style, dark plum-brown outer contour, simple cel-shaded masses, restrained texture, no photorealistic metal or 3D render. Center on a square genuinely transparent RGBA canvas with even safety padding; clean silhouette suitable for rotation, no directional lighting that breaks rotation. No background, floor, text, UI, speed lines, particles, long trail, extra objects or cropped parts.
